title: Te Taumahatanga i Kawea Mai ai te Whakaora
intro: I te whakamātautau nui i te wairua, i tangohia te whakamarie, ngā hoa, me te kaha tinana. I a ia e noho mokemoke ana i roto i te mamae nui, ka tahuri tēnei pononga a Allah ki te Atua anake. Nā te manawanui korekore me te inoi pono, ka tae mai te tai o te aroha noa i nui atu i ngā tumanakohanga katoa. Ko wai tēnei tangata nāna nei te aroha i whakatuwhera te tatau o te whakaoranga?
clues: He pononga ahau nā Allah, i pārekareka ki te nui o te taonga, ki te whare rangatira, ā, i pai hoki te hauora i ōku rā.
Kātahi ka puta he whakamātautau: kua riro te taonga, kua riro te hunga i arohaina, ā, i pāngia tōku kikokiko e te mamae nui.
Kāore i taea e te hunga e tata ana ki ahau te tu atu ki tōku āhua, ā, i mahue mokemoke ahau, e kī ana i te mamae nui.
I karanga ahau ki tōku Ariki, me te kī kua pā mai a Hātana ki ahau me te ngenge me te whiu.
I tae mai te whakautu—he whakahau kia patua te whenua ki tōku waewae, ā, mai i reira ka pupu mai te wai matao hei whakaora.
I tangohia rawatia e tōku Ariki te raruraru, ā, i whakahokia mai tōku whānau ki ahau, i whakanuia, hei tohu aroha ki te hunga e whakaaroaro ana.

arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verse: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding. (38:43)
